#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;
const int maxN = 70;
const int maxn = 50;
const int lim = 22;

LL binom[maxN + 5][maxN + 5];

void precompute_binom() {
    for (int i = 0; i < maxN; ++i) {
        binom[i][0] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j)
            binom[i][j] = binom[i - 1][j - 1] + binom[i - 1][j];
    }
}

int n, m, N, mid;
int g[maxN + 5];
vector<pair<LL, int>> partb[maxn + 5][maxn + 5];

void dfs_partb(int x, int cnta, int cntb, LL sum = 0) {
    if (x == mid) {
        partb[cnta][cntb].push_back(make_pair(sum, 1));
        return;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
        if (g[x - 1] != -1 && i != g[x - 1]) continue;
        LL tmp = 0;
        if (i == 0) {
            if (cnta > 0) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                    tmp += binom[cnta - 1][n - 1] * binom[cntb][j] * binom[N - x][n - j];
                dfs_partb(x - 1, cnta - 1, cntb, sum + tmp);
            }
        } else {
            if (cntb > 0) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                    tmp -= binom[cntb - 1][n - 1] * binom[cnta][j] * binom[N - x][n - j];
                dfs_partb(x - 1, cnta, cntb - 1, sum + tmp);
            }
        }
    }
}

map<LL, LL> parta[maxn + 5][maxn + 5];
LL ans = LLONG_MAX, ans_cnt = 0;

void update(const LL &val, const LL &cnt) {
    if (val < ans) { ans = val; ans_cnt = cnt; }
    else if (val == ans) ans_cnt += cnt;
}

void bfs_parta() {
    for (int i = 0; i <= n + m; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j <= n + m; ++j)
            parta[i][j].clear();
    parta[0][0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i <= n + m; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= n + m; ++j) {
            for (auto &u : parta[i][j]) {
                if (i + j == mid) {
                    int p = lower_bound(partb[i][j].begin(), partb[i][j].end(), make_pair(-u.first, -1)) - partb[i][j].begin();
                    if (p < (int)partb[i][j].size())
                        update(abs(u.first + partb[i][j][p].first), u.second * partb[i][j][p].second);
                    if (p) {
                        update(abs(u.first + partb[i][j][p - 1].first), u.second * partb[i][j][p - 1].second);
                    }
                } else {
                    int p = i + j;
                    for (int k = 0; k < 2; ++k) {
                        if (g[p] != -1 && k != g[p]) continue;
                        int cnta = i, cntb = j;
                        if (k == 0) ++cnta;
                        else ++cntb;
                        if (cnta <= n + m && cntb <= n + m) {
                            LL tmp = 0;
                            if (k == 0) {
                                for (int l = 0; l < n; ++l)
                                    tmp += binom[cnta - 1][n - 1] * binom[cntb][l] * binom[N - p - 1][n - l];
                            } else {
                                for (int l = 0; l < n; ++l)
                                    tmp -= binom[cntb - 1][n - 1] * binom[cnta][l] * binom[N - p - 1][n - l];
                            }
                            parta[cnta][cntb][u.first + tmp] += u.second;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

    for (int i = 0; i <= n + m; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j <= n + m; ++j)
            partb[i][j].clear();
    dfs_partb(N, n + m, n + m);
    for (int i = 0; i <= n + m; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= n + m; ++j) {
            sort(partb[i][j].begin(), partb[i][j].end());
            vector<pair<LL, int>> tmp;
            int sz = (int)partb[i][j].size();
            for (int k = 0; k < sz; ) {
                LL cur = partb[i][j][k].first;
                int cnt = 0;
                while (k < sz && partb[i][j][k].first == cur) {
                    cnt += partb[i][j][k].second;
                    ++k;
                }
                tmp.push_back(make_pair(cur, cnt));
            }
            partb[i][j] = tmp;
        }
    }
    bfs_parta();

    freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);

    }
    work();
    cout << ans_cnt << endl;
    return 0;
}

                    }
                } else {
